svg.title: HYDRA-UMC-OPS-AGENT architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC-OPS-AGENT has an edge role that collects evidence and a control role that diagnoses, proposes, collects a signed approval, deploys a canary through the updater and verifies, with an audit journal.
